name: DiceRollInfo
title: DiceRoll Info.csv
description: The dice rolls of each space: one row per kind of roll per visit, with what each of the six faces does. The game, the editor and the safety checks read this description, so a new column is declared once, here. Keys starting x- are this project's own hints.

fields.name: space_name
fields.title: Space name
fields.description: The space this roll belongs to.

fields.name: die_roll
fields.title: What the roll decides
fields.description: The kind of roll, such as Next Step (where the player goes), W Cards, Fees Paid. Read from the data; new kinds need no code change in the file itself.

fields.title: Face 1
fields.description: What happens on a 1: a space to go to, or an effect such as Draw 1.

fields.name: roll_group
fields.title: Roll group
fields.description: Effects with the same group name share one roll. Blank means they all share one roll.
